guidelines: ICMR-NIN Dietary Guidelines / Endocrine Society Guidelines for Polycystic Ovary Syndrome
principles: Low Glycemic Index (GI) and High Fiber: Focus on whole legumes (chickpeas, lentils, moong), millets (ragi, jowar, bajra), and non-starchy vegetables to avoid postprandial insulin surges.
Healthy Fats & Anti-inflammatory Omega-3s: Incorporate flaxseeds, chia seeds, walnuts, and extra virgin olive oil to downregulate systemic inflammation.
Adequate Clean Protein: 0.8 - 1.0g protein per kg body weight (paneer, tofu, Greek yogurt, lentils, eggs) to stabilize satiety hormones (GLP-1 and peptide YY).
Avoid ultra-processed foods, high-fructose corn syrups, and refined bakery carbs.

guidelines: WHO Guideline on Daily Iron and Folic Acid Supplementation in Menstruating Women / ICMR Anaemia Mukt Bharat
principles: Dietary Sources: Combine heme iron (eggs, lean poultry) or non-heme iron (spinach, methi, moringa leaves, beetroot, jaggery, lentils).
Enhancer Pairing: Always consume plant-based iron with Vitamin C (lemon juice, amla, bell peppers, tomatoes) to multiply non-heme iron bioavailability by 3-4x.
Inhibitor Separation: Avoid drinking tea, coffee, or calcium-rich milk within 1 hour before or after iron-dense meals, as polyphenols and calcium inhibit iron absorption.
